title: Thomas Benton's sister and Amacker's moves to Chicago and Los Angeles
summary: Amacker gives dates: left New Orleans in 1919 for Chicago, to Los Angeles in January 1921, back in 1953; a bank book confirms it.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: jack. He's been dead. His sister's living now, Thomas Benton's sister. Is she in his neighborhood? Yeah. She lives at, let me see, she lives 3924 Magnolia Street now. 3924 Magnolia? Yeah, Thomas Benton's sister. I was talking to her yesterday. And she's glad to see me. She hadn't seen me in 50 years until yesterday. Oh she's up near Dave Bailey. You know Dave Bailey, a drummer. Yeah, she hadn't seen me 50 years until yesterday. And she told me to come see us sometime. And I just played her brother years ago. Thomas died in 47, you know. He's a guitar player, a mandolin player, a bass player, a nice guitar player. Played a star, he sent me playing it now. When did you leave town? I left here in 19, let's see. I left New Orleans in 1919. Went to Chicago. And I'm in the latter part of the 19, stayed there until the 28th day. Let me see, let's see. Stayed there all through. I left Chicago on the 28th day, on the 28th, rather, of December, 1920. I left Chicago on the 28th of December, 1920, headed for Los Angeles. I got to Los Angeles the first of January, 1921. And I stayed in Los Angeles then until 25 before I come away from there. Then I come away from there in 25 and comes back here. Stays here about three weeks, about three weeks. Goes back to Los Angeles. Then I didn't leave Los Angeles then until 48th, 25. Then come back down in 48th. Then I goes back out there after about three weeks, in 48th. Then I come back then and right around 53. I've been back here since.
